description: Hi, I am Shiv. I created this team as we can discover more about space and work together as a group.
summary:
Lunar Escape is an educational space simulation game where players become a young astronaut responsible for building humanity's first sustainable Moon base. This is meant for ages 7-12.
Players must manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, power, and astronaut wellbeing while learning about the challenges of living on the Moon. Throughout the mission, interactive guides teach real facts about lunar exploration, sustainability, and space technology.
The main objective is to get lost resources and learn what they are and what they do. Then you build and deploy a rover and escape a storm. Once the storm is over and the player gets in the rocket, the player successfully completes the mission and returns to Earth.
By combining science, problem-solving, and interactive gameplay, Lunar Escape helps students understand humanity's nearest celestial neighbor while inspiring future space exploration
details: Lunar Escape is an educational space adventure game for ages 7-12 where players become a young astronaut building and managing a Moon base. Players collect vital resources, learn their purpose, build a rover, survive a lunar storm, and safely return to Earth. Through interactive gameplay, students explore real concepts in lunar science, sustainability, and space exploration while developing problem-solving skills. 🚀🌕
